what: The rarest official PS2 consoles, for the dashboard's Rarest page. Official Sony hardware only: retail models, limited colours, commemorative and promotional editions, Sony devices with a PS2 inside, and development units (marked not_retail). No custom paint, shells or mods. ebay_prices.py looks each one up once a day on eBay US and eBay UK (or the one site in "sites"), from sellers anywhere.
method: Web research on 2026-10-08 with WebSearch and WebFetch. Model numbers, dates and limits taken from Sony press releases (sonyinteractive.com, sony.mediaroom.com, SCEE release), Japanese and English Wikipedia, Obsolete Sony, news articles and collector forums. Prices are PriceCharting's current figures (US, PAL and Japanese PS2 'Systems' tables, all in USD) read on 2026-10-08; no eBay UK/GBP prices were gathered, so gbp is null throughout. consolevariations.com and rfgeneration.com were not fetched (robots.txt); search snippets from them were only used to find candidate names. Ranking: (1) stated production numbers under ~10,000 first; (2) never-sold, single-retailer or single-bundle units; (3) single-country limited colours and Japan-only retail devices; (4) multi-country or large-run limited colours. Within tiers 2-4 (after the hand-ordered dev units, Bravia and PSX silver) entries are sorted by PriceCharting value, max(loose, CIB/2). Stated large runs (Ocean Blue, Zen Black 500,000) are ranked by value. Each entry's 'tier' and 'rank_basis' say which rule placed it. ebay_search: 'queries' are search strings; a listing title should contain every 'require' word and at least one 'require_any' word, and none of 'exclude'. 'controller' alone is not excluded because console listings often say 'with controller'.
gaps: Not confirmed: the Japanese colour suffixes of the five Automobile consoles and the European SCPH-30004 R model number (only a US 'SCPH-30001 R' unit is attested); whether the 666-per-region figure is exact (one forum says 2,000 per colour); Ocean Blue/Zen Black run sizes (500,000 vs 50,000–250,000; Japanese Wikipedia calls them regular colours); the 5,000 figure for Toys Blue (one source); exact model numbers for the US 2006 silver slim, the US white slim and the PAL Aqua/Satin Silver fat units; pink slims reported for Oceania/Asia (model numbers not found). No production counts exist for any Japanese spring/summer colour, the FFXII and Gundam packs, the PSX silver or the dev units. Left out: Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards PS2 (PriceCharting lists 'SCPH-39001', 2003, no sales, no description) and a Haribo PS2 (consolevariations title only), because nothing showed they were Sony-made; the Need for Speed Most Wanted car-shaped PS2 (a custom case built for EA, unofficial); the Audiovox VOD10PS2 in-car unit (contains a PS2 but is made by Audiovox, not Sony); the US 'GT3 Racing Pack', 'Combo Pack', 'Online Pack' and other bundles whose console is standard. Value data is PriceCharting only, in USD; no eBay UK or GBP figures were collected, and PriceCharting's rarest rows rest on very few sales.

tiers.1: A one-off, or a stated run of 5,000 or fewer.
tiers.2: Never sold in shops, or sold through one retailer or in one bundle.
tiers.3: Limited to one country, or sold only in Japan.
tiers.4: Limited across several countries, or made in large numbers.
